audit.whatIsWrong: Every line tells you to engage 'on Permafrost's cooldown'. Permafrost is on a 1.5s cooldown — it is gated by Frost stacks, not by a cooldown you can bait.
audit.why: Riot's E text: it stuns 'an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', and her W (9s at rank 1) plus autos are what build them. The real window is being unstacked with her Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) spent.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around Frost stacks and the Q cooldown.

audit.why: Arctic Assault 18s, Winter's Wrath 9s, Permafrost 1.5s, Glacial Prison 120s at rank 1; Maokai W 14s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and whys[4].

edits.before: Bait his key tool — root him on the Permafrost cooldown and grind him with saplings. Maokai wins the Permafrost cooldown windows.
edits.after: Permafrost has no real cooldown — it fires once her Frost stacks cap. Trade when you are unstacked and Arctic Assault (18s) is spent.

edits.before: Root him on the Permafrost cooldown and grind him with saplings. Track Permafrost before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Root her once your Frost stacks drop off and Arctic Assault (18s) is spent, then grind her with saplings and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost is a 1.5s stun gated on max Frost stacks — step up unstacked, after her W (9s) is spent.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost (1.5s): not a cooldown you bait — it fires the moment Frost stacks cap, so trade unstacked. - Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) is her gap-closer: step up once it is spent. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp lets you wall her engage or set a gank, and you still out-sustain her single-target poke here.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp only sets a gank here — her Glacial Prison stuns on landing and the Frost-stack E ends the 1v1 first.

edits.before: Nature's Grasp lets you wall her into a gank or peel her engage, and you still out-sustain her single-target poke at this level.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp sets your jungler's gank or peels her Arctic Assault, but Glacial Prison stuns first in a straight 1v1 — never solo-commit.
